text.en: Expecting a beam of atoms passing through a Stern-Gerlach magnet to spread into a continuous smear on the detector, as a classical magnetic dipole with a random orientation would, rather than splitting into a small number of discrete spots.
text.et: Ootamine, et Sterni-Gerlachi magnetit läbiv aatomikimp jaotub detektoril pidevaks häguks, nagu juhusliku orientatsiooniga klassikaline magnetdipool käituks, mitte ei jagune väikeseks arvuks diskreetseteks laikudeks.
